purpose: Add a materially different exact SMT representation for the primitive k-disjoint-zero-sum predicate, calibrate it independently against brute-force semantics and published small-group controls, and expose semantic mutation sensitivity without consuming the protected D4 target.

solver.representation: one integer assignment variable per sequence occurrence with value -1 for unused or 0..k-1 for its unique zero-sum bin
constraints: each occurrence belongs to at most one bin by construction of the single assignment variable
for every bin and group coordinate, the sum of selected coordinate residues is congruent to zero modulo the coordinate order

calibration.required_cross_check: every sequence-bearing frozen control must agree among published expected answer, the Z3 representation, and an independent brute-force assignment enumeration implemented in this backend
additional_exhaustive_small_domains: all multisets of C3 of length 0..5 for k up to min(3,n)
all multisets of C2 x C2 of length 0..4 for k up to min(3,n)

required_semantic_mutations: allow the same occurrence to be reused across bins
change the group modulus from 5 to 3 on a discriminating control
mutation_rule: each mutant must disagree with the correct backend on a predeclared small control for the semantic reason it targets; a source/hash mismatch is not sufficient
unsat_authority_boundary: A Z3 UNSAT result is a solver decision, not an independently checked lower-bound certificate. This backend does not satisfy the issue #49 requirement for an independently produced proof/certificate for every excluded D4 branch.
reviewer_boundary: Machine calibration does not satisfy the independent-human mathematical proof audit checkbox.
next_authorized_step: After separate one-shot D4 authorization, this generic backend may be bound to an independently generated target proposition. That future execution must receive a new result identity and cannot be inferred from this calibration artifact.
